NONE: B1 a polite way of talking to a woman
（用以禮貌地稱呼婦女）夫人，太太
› in Britain, used to address the Queen, or a woman of high rank in particular organizations, such as the army or the police
（在英國對女王或軍隊、警隊等機構中職位較高婦女的稱呼）夫人
› in the past, used when talking to a woman of higher social class
（舊時用於稱呼上層社會的婦女）夫人，女士

example: How can I help you, ma'am?
